$comment: Approximate seconds each real-binary acceptance spec file takes in CI, used only to balance the Colab acceptance shards (typescript/scripts/colab-acceptance-shards.mjs).
A stale or missing weight costs balance, never coverage: every spec file always lands in exactly one shard (guarded by typescript/test/tooling/colab-acceptance-shards.test.ts).

Whole seconds, the mean of the per-test durations of two full green runs of the sharded suite on 2026-10-12 (runs 38218284566 and 38222074650, both shards each; one file's time varied by up to 1.6x between them). Recompute from the colab-acceptance-results artifacts' outcomes.json when the suite changes.
reply-notifications.spec.ts: six cases totalled 49.7 seconds in the fresh frozen-native headless run for #2981/#2850 on 2026-10-13; rounded to 50 after adding the persistent-unread case.
